title: The Good, Bad, and Dangerous in Hegseth’s Pentagon Overhaul
gist: David Ignatius argues Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's Pentagon overhaul mixes a dangerous purge of the officer corps — 26 generals and admirals fired, ~55 promotions blocked, a 20% cut to general officer ranks — with overdue procurement reforms. He backs a new Autonomous Warfare Command, a Musk/Luckey/Gingrich 120-day future-of-war review and hardened base supply chains, but criticizes state bidding for a new base and moves on military education and religion.

insights.claim: Hegseth has dismissed 26 generals and admirals and blocked or withheld promotions of about 55 others, per a congressional official's count, and now targets a 20 percent total reduction in general officer ranks (10 percent fired plus 10 percent of slots eliminated).
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Leadership turnover at this scale raises execution risk across U.S. military operations and programs.
insights.quote: So yes, 20 percent reduction across the board.
